jobs.title: Threat Hunter
jobs.description: Job title: Threat Hunting - 8/5 Support Workplace type: On-site Location: Karle Tech Park, Bangalore, India Job type: Full-time (Long term) About the Role We are looking for an experienced Threat Hunter to proactively identify, investigate, and mitigate advanced cyber threats that evade traditional, alert-driven security controls. You will run hypothesis-driven and intelligence-led hunts across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud environments to reduce dwell time and improve detection maturity. Must-Have: Hands-On Microsoft Sentinel Experience Key Responsibilities Conduct hypothesis-based and IOC-driven threat hunts across: Endpoint (EDR/XDR) SIEM / log management platforms (Microsoft Sentinel preferred) Network telemetry (NDR) Identity logs (AD / Entra ID) Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, M365) Identify stealthy and advanced threats, including: Living-off-the-Land (LotL) techniques Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) Lateral movement and privilege escalation Insider threat indicators Develop and execute MITRE ATT&CK-aligned hunting hypotheses Convert hunting findings into: Security incidents New detection rules (Sentinel / SIEM / EDR / XDR) Change or service requests (misconfigurations, logging gaps) Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, and Threat Intelligence teams Produce hunting reports and KPIs (dwell time reduction, hunts-to-detections, incidents generated) Technical Skills Microsoft Sentinel (hands-on, mandatory) Strong expertise in SIEM/SOAR platforms (Splunk, Chronicle, Palo Alto XSIAM are a plus) Hands-on experience with EDR/XDR tools (Microsoft XDR, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Palo Alto Cortex) Proficiency in KQL / SPL / advanced hunting queries Deep understanding of MITRE ATT&CK techniques and TTPs Strong OS knowledge: Windows, Linux, macOS Basic scripting skills (PowerShell / Python preferred) Cloud security exposure (Azure, AWS, M365 Defender) Experience & Soft Skills 6+ years in SOC / threat detection, with 2+ years in threat hunting Strong analytical and investigative mindset Client-facing reporting and presentation skills Comfortable working on-site at Karle Tech Park, Bangalore How to Apply Fill the Form - https://forms.gle/jU9Qn5Pm34bBn14k7 Click Apply or send your resume to jyotsna.mahajan@arborvitae.in

jobs.title: Cyber Security Intern
jobs.description: Company Description Weskill is an innovative online training platform focused on upskilling undergraduate students with industry-relevant capabilities. The organization provides practical, hands-on learning experiences designed to bridge the gap between academic curricula and real-world corporate expectations. Through structured programs and mentorship, Weskill helps learners gain confidence in applying technical knowledge to professional scenarios. Graduates are equipped to pursue opportunities in fast-growing startups and leading multinational companies, supporting a strong foundation for future career success. Role Description The Cyber Security Intern role at Weskill is a remote internship focused on supporting security initiatives across applications, networks, and information systems. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with security assessments, reviewing logs for potential threats, documenting findings, and supporting the implementation of best practices in cybersecurity. The intern will help analyze vulnerabilities, contribute to basic incident response activities under supervision, and collaborate with mentors on security-related research and reporting. This role offers exposure to real-world security challenges while providing structured guidance to build core cybersecurity skills. Qualifications Candidates should possess foundational skills in Cybersecurity and general Cyber concepts, including threat awareness and security best practices. Candidates should possess skills in Application Security to help identify and understand common software vulnerabilities and secure coding principles. Candidates should possess skills in Network Security to support monitoring, basic configuration review, and protection of networked systems. Candidates should possess skills in Information Security, including data protection principles, access control, and understanding security policies. Current enrollment in an undergraduate program in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a willingness to learn new tools and techniques. Basic familiarity with operating systems, networking fundamentals, and security tools (e.g., firewalls, antivirus, or SIEM platforms) is an advantage. Effective written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating with mentors and team members.

jobs.description: Experience Bachelor's degree in informatics engineering or related field Officer/Engineer: 2–4 years in networking or network security. Senior/Lead: 5+ years, preferably in insurance, banking, or another financial services company.
